redflags-001.text: monthly_metrics.csv shows MRR of $186,739 for 2026-09. The subscription rows add to $171,739. The $15,000 difference is 8.7% of subscription MRR and equals the non-subscription lines: Marlow Veterinary Group (Pilot, $15,000). Months over tolerance: 2026-08, 2026-09. Mislabel kind a: non-recurring revenue in MRR.

redflags-002.text: The P&L row "Subscription revenue" matches subscription revenue in the customer file in all 21 actual months (largest difference $0). Billings differ from revenue by more than 1.0% in 18 of those months, which annual plans paid up front explain on their own. scans/redflags/mislabels.py summed the columns in the header row cited.

redflags-003.text: Ledger lines tie to P&L cost of revenue plus operating expenses in all 21 actual months (largest difference $0). No ledger line names a contractor, consultant, freelancer, agency or statement of work.

redflags-004.text: Every ledger line is booked as one of Cost of revenue, G&A, R&D, S&M; none names an asset. The cash bridge difference is -$0.24 against cash of $1,800,000. scans/redflags/mislabels.py summed the columns in the header row cited.

redflags-005.text: Billed but not yet earned at 2026-09: $104,876 across 28 customers. The P&L row "Subscription revenue" does not exceed revenue earned in any month, and ARR_Build Subscription ARR ($2,060,868) is 12 times 2026-09 subscription revenue. scans/redflags/mislabels.py summed the columns in the header row cited.

redflags-006.text: One-time fees of $9,500 in 2026-09 are not in the mrr column: the gap between mrr and subscription MRR is $15,000, not the fee total, and the ARR_Build row "Onboarding fees" counts $0 of ARR.

redflags-007.text: The deck's ARR of $2,500,000 (slide 3) differs from the P&L's $2,240,868 (12 x 'Recurring revenue (subscription plus pilot)' for 2026-09), a gap of 11.6%.

redflags-008.text: The deck's revenue chart on slide 3 has 21 bars for 2025-01 to 2026-09; their shape matches 'Recurring revenue (subscription plus pilot)' in the P&L (largest difference 0.4 points of the tallest bar).

sources.quote: Monthly recurring revenue, January 2025 to September 2026.

redflags-009.text: The revenue chart on slide 3 starts at 2025-01, the first revenue month in the books, and runs to 2026-09 with no month left out.

sources.quote: Monthly recurring revenue, January 2025 to September 2026.

redflags-010.text: The deck's plan growth of 3.5% a month (slide 11) matches the model's plan columns, which grow 3.50% to 3.50% a month. It is a plan, not a period the books hold as actuals.

sources.quote: Revenue grows 3.5% a month in the plan.
